title: End card
description: A closing card: a logo image, a title and one line, eased in within the first second and then completely still for the rest of the item, so the last frame holds; optionally on a solid plate. Sizes are a share of the frame's short side, with a floor. Takes a theme.

line.default: Every clip makes the next one cheaper

size.description: Title size in % of the frame's short side

plate.description: Draw the card on a solid plate (the theme surface) filling its box

author: claude-opus-5-5
note: Optional solid plate: a small card on a dark frame read as black frames in the render report.
